title: Madden's turn to UFOs: 2017 openness and the 2021 Pentagon press conference

tellings.quote: I think like a lot of people I got kind of, you know, triggered about the UFO in like 2017 when, you know, when suddenly it was okay to talk about this, you know. Um and then I remember in I think it was 2021, I always tell the story, I was watching X Files with my kids that summer and it was right when the big first Pentagon press conference happened

plain: A guest named James Madden, who talks with Michels about Plato's cave and consciousness, says he got pulled into UFOs in 2017, "when suddenly it was okay to talk about this." He tells Michels that in the summer of what he thinks was 2021 he was watching The X-Files with his kids just as the first big Pentagon press conference on the subject happened. He tells it as his own turning point, a sign of how public openness drew ordinary people like him in.
